This is a sample document. It describes a product that does not exist.
It is published so you can see the shape of an Annex VII gap report before signing up. Nothing in it was recorded by anyone, it is not evidence of anything, and it must not be filed or forwarded as though it were.

A gap here means “not recorded in this service”. It does not mean the requirement is unmet.
Slots marked not recorded may well be satisfied by material held elsewhere. Read this document as an inventory of what this service holds, not as an assessment of the product.

The rest happens in the agent

This console is read-only. The work happens in your coding agent, in the repository the answers come from: settling scope, deciding each risk, attaching evidence with its provenance, recording a vulnerability as actively exploited, drafting the ENISA report. A browser cannot see your repository, which is why this is an MCP server rather than a portal.

Daily SBOM scanning against OSV and CISA KEV, the Article 14 clocks that opened the obligations above, and the audit trail behind every row on this page all run there too.
